label: GPT-5.6 Luna
headline: Battle Belt Widens as Marban, Gutter Stir
war_summary: The latest returns show the contested belt broadening since the last edition. Gutter has risen from 83 to 91 strategic-base events in 24 hours, though its immediate casualty and enlistment rates have cooled; its holdings remain entirely Colonial. MarbanHollow has made the sharpest advance in activity, climbing from 21 to 30 events, with five recorded in the latest two hours and a divided ledger of four Warden, three Colonial, and one neutral base. WeatheredExpanse has edged from 50 to 51 events, including three in the latest two hours, while casualties remain heavy and both sides still hold four and three bases respectively, with two neutral. OlavisWake now stands at 14 events, up from the previous report’s eight, and recorded three recent changes amid a mixed five-base ledger. PalantineBerm remains at 25 daily events but has seen no fresh change in the latest six hours. KuuraStrand is the newest sharp flare, with two events in two hours, accelerating casualties and enlistments, and five Warden bases against one Colonial. Several rear sectors remain quiet; no victor is declared.

label: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
headline: Gutter Settles to Colonial Colors as Kuura Strand Burns and East Cools
war_summary: Since the last edition the Gutter has been settled: its seven works now stand wholly Colonial, and the two-hour action count there has fallen from seven to two, though ninety-one actions were logged across the day. The Weathered Expanse remains the war's furnace — fifty-one actions in the day, three in the past two hours — its lines unchanged at four Warden, three Colonial and two unclaimed works, with 6,728 Colonial and 8,151 Warden casualties in the day. The eastern eruptions have banked: Olavis Wake and Pari Peak, both alight overnight, report three and one actions respectively in the past two hours. Fresh heat instead appears at Kuura Strand, where 371 Colonial and 218 Warden fell in two hours and Martti passed to Colonial hands; five of its six works remain Warden. Marban Hollow stays lively, five actions in two hours around Checkpoint Bua and Oster Wall. Callahans Passage bears the heaviest day's toll, 7,477 Colonial against 5,841 Warden, without a work changing hands. Colonials now hold 317 works to the Warden 114, with five unclaimed.

colonial_reinforce.reason: Spirit Watch has flipped ownership many times in the recorded events and sits in the highest-casualty region (714 Colonial / 601 Warden deaths in the last 2h); holding a Colonial relic that keeps changing hands protects the line in WeatheredExpanse.

colonial_attack.reason: Ilmari Bridge is the Warden relic left between the Colonial-held Yöohja and Kulkue after repeated Colonial captures in OlavisWake; the region shows a Colonial-favourable casualty ratio (0.79) and sustained high enlistment activity.

warden_reinforce.reason: KuuraStrand casualties spiked almost entirely inside the last 2h (371 Colonial / 218 Warden deaths vs only 399/251 over 24h) and Martti was just recorded as captured by Colonials, exposing the northern Warden relic line.

warden_attack.reason: Necropolis is a Colonial relic that has stayed Colonial since the 08:36 window while Wardens recorded captures of nearby Crow's Nest, Frostmarch and Wightwalk; WeatheredExpanse remains the highest-casualty region in the packet.

label: GLM 5.3 Flash
headline: Kuura Strand Erupts as Gutter Falls Fully Colonial
war_summary: Kuura Strand has burst into flame since our last edition, its casualty ledger swelling from single figures to better than three hundred and seventy Colonial and two hundred and eighteen Warden losses in two hours as flags turned at Martti, leaving one Colonial toehold among five Warden posts. Olavis Wake, the front we led with before, has cooled markedly — from thousand-loss hours to a few hundred — though Iltaku and Kulkue still saw movement as this report closed. Gutter's map has been settled: after ninety-one changes on the day, the Warden foothold is swept away and all seven posts now fly Colonial colors, the past two hours grown still. Weathered Expanse grinds on with fifty-one flag events on the day, Spirit Watch the busiest ground and its two ruined posts unrebuilt. Marban Hollow has come back to life, Checkpoint Bua and Oster Wall again the busiest ground. The Nevish Line, costly at day's peak, has gone quiet. This is the war's 655th day; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize.

colonial_reinforce.reason: Kulkue was captured only ~20 minutes before cutoff in the region with the highest sustained fighting; Warden losses are still running ~123/hr, so a fast warden counterattack on this thinly-held fresh gain is likely and it needs garrison consolidation now.

colonial_attack.reason: Ilmari Bridge is the nearest remaining Warden base to the freshly taken Yöohja-Kulkue crescent; pressing the push while regional fighting and enlistment inflow stay high could collapse the Warden bridgehead before it is reinforced.

warden_reinforce.reason: Wightwalk was just retaken at 23:01 in the hottest sector on the map; colonial casualties are spiking (420/hr, +126 change), signaling a heavy colonial response is already building against this fresh holding.

warden_attack.reason: Pariah flipped three times in four hours and currently sits Colonial with minimal regional pressure (colonial 2h delta of 8); a quick warden strike can retake it before the Colonials entrench their evening gains.

label: Muse Spark 1.3
headline: Marban Hollow Surges as Gutter Clash Persists
war_summary: Three hours on the wires have cooled the northern flashpoints and shifted the weight south. Marban Hollow now leads the late returns with five changes in two hours and thirty in the day around Checkpoint Bua and Oster Wall, standing at four Warden, three Colonial and one neutral, while Weathered Expanse follows with three in two and fifty-one in the day around Spirit Watch, Crow's Nest and Frostmarch at four Warden, three Colonial and two neutral. Gutter remains the day's busiest board with ninety-one changes in twenty-four hours, though only two in the last two around Kuoppa and The Parras, now listed wholly Colonial. Olavis Wake eases to three in two and fourteen in the day around Iltaku and Kulkue at two Warden and three Colonial, and Pari Peak to one in two and fourteen in the day at Pariah. Kuura Strand shows two late changes at Martti amid sharp casualties. Callahan's Passage and Stonecradle still report heavy daily losses without a recorded change, and Nevish Line, Palantine Berm, Stlican Shelf and Linn Mercy have gone quiet in the last two hours.

colonial_attack.reason: Sustained high Colonial pressure in OlavisWake with favorable loss ratio supports pushing a Warden relic.

colonial_reinforce.reason: Newly taken Colonial town under immediate intense contact with surging casualties needs consolidation.

warden_attack.reason: Volatile Colonial town in the highest-tempo OlavisWake fight is the most exposed counter-attack target.
